user.title: Connect to the Tablo service
user.description: The service runs next to Home Assistant and draws the panel. Its settings are imported from it.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The service no longer accepts the token. Enter TABLO_API_TOKEN from its .env.

error.cannot_connect: The service does not answer at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The service refused the API token.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Button 8 is fixed: full refresh and diagnostics.

data_description.icon: Empty: the icon of the entity.

data.duration_s: How long it stays on screen
data.title: Message title

data_description.entity: Toggle: a light or switch. Run: a script, scene, automation or button.
data_description.duration_s: For a QR or a message. Empty: the default from Screen.

data.duration_s: How long it stays on screen
data.title: Message title

data_description.entity: Toggle: a light or switch. Run: a script, scene, automation or button.
data_description.duration_s: For a QR or a message. Empty: the default from Screen.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi networks
wifi.description: One network per line: `SSID | password | WPA | hidden`. Security is WPA, WEP or nopass; the last field only for a hidden network.

sources.title: Sources

data_description.bot: Its username, for the link in the the university app login notification.

sources.description: Deadlines, news and grades come from infomaster and are set up in its Mini App.

home.title: Home block
home.description: Up to 5 rows, one per line: `label | template`. Home Assistant renders each template and the panel follows its changes; an empty result hides the row (e.g. printing only while printing). Without a label (`| template`) the value starts at the left edge.

show_qr.name: Show Wi-Fi QR
show_qr.description: Shows QR codes of the Wi-Fi networks on the panel.

networks.name: Networks
networks.description: SSIDs from the Tablo settings. Empty: all.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows a message over the whole panel.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds on screen. Default 30. Ignored for a sticky message.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Stays until a button is pressed and comes back after a restart. Several wait in a queue.

clear_messages.name: Clear messages
clear_messages.description: Drops the sticky messages and takes the shown one off the panel.

full_refresh.name: Full refresh
full_refresh.description: Redraws the panel fully, clearing ghosting.

refresh_data.name: Refresh data
refresh_data.description: Polls the sources now instead of on their schedule.
